description: Get one feedback widget comment with its full reply thread, its page location and version, and a signed screenshot URL when one was captured. Find the id with list_feedback.

feedback_id.description: Comment (feedback) UUID, the `id` returned by list_feedback.

name: get_feedback

anchor_label.description: The page element the comment is pinned to, when snapped to one.

device_info.description: Browser, viewport and device details recorded by the widget, or null.

page_url.description: Full URL of the page the comment was left on.

is_team_reply.description: True for a reply from the product team rather than the person who left the comment.

screenshot_url.description: Signed screenshot URL, valid for one hour, or null when none was captured.

status.description: new (nobody has looked yet), reviewed (assessed, still open), resolved (confirmed fixed) or dismissed (will not act on it).

version.description: Page version label (v1, v2, ...), or null when the comment carries no version.

title: Get comment
